app.title: MemorySmith
app.tagline: Structured knowledge, natively readable and writable by humans and agents.

auth.mfaHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.hostedHint: You will be taken to the sign-in page and brought back here.
auth.handingOver: Taking you to the sign-in page...
auth.handoverFailed: The sign-in did not complete. Try again.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired and was ended here. Signing in again picks up exactly where you left off: nothing was lost.
auth.noneSubscription: This account reaches no subscription yet. A subscription is what holds your notebooks, and it is granted by hand while there is no automatic billing.
auth.pendingSubscription: Your subscription is waiting for approval. Approval is manual at this stage, and the product opens as soon as it is granted.
auth.blockedSubscription: This subscription is not active at the moment. Nothing was lost: the data stays exactly where it is and becomes reachable again once access is restored.

search.invalid: Invalid query. Check the quotes, parentheses and operators.
search.syntaxHint: Searches the whole text. Accepts "exact phrase", -exclude, OR, name:, folder:, section:, content: and frontmatter attributes, such as maturity:evergreen.

structure.outlineHint: The folder tree with each folder's description. It is what tells the agent where each note goes.
structure.heading: Notebook Context
structure.intro: How this notebook describes itself, and what the agent receives from get_notebook_context: the Guidance says what the notebook is, each folder says what belongs in it, and the folder Template says how a note is laid out.
structure.guidanceHint: What this notebook is and how to write in it
structure.noTemplates: No folder in this notebook declares a Template.

folder.templateHint: Suggested layout for notes in this folder. The server never validates against it.
folder.empty: No notes in this folder yet.

note.embedSectionMissing: The section "{{section}}" is not in this note.
note.writeConflict: That change was not saved. Someone wrote here first, and the content was reloaded.
note.pendingLink: Pending link: the target note does not exist yet.
note.remoteImages_one: Opening this note fetched an image from {{hosts}}, so that site was told your address and the moment you read this.
note.remoteImages_other: Opening this note fetched images from {{count}} other sites — {{hosts}} — so each of them was told your address and the moment you read this.
note.refusedLink: This address is not one the reading surface follows, so the text stays and the link does not.
note.copyHint: Copy the note's Markdown to the clipboard
note.attachmentMissing: This notebook holds no file by that name. Attachments are not stored here.
note.targetPending: No note carries the name “{{target}}” yet. The link is kept and resolves on its own when one does.
note.targetAmbiguous_other: {{count}} notes carry this name, so the link reaches all of them. Which one did you mean?
note.targetByAlias: No name matched, so these match by alias — and one of them gives the link up the day somebody writes a note under this name.

dashboard.heading: Overview
dashboard.noFacets: These notebooks declare no attributes in their notes yet, so there is nothing to chart.
dashboard.moreFacets: {{count}} more attribute(s) counted but not charted.
dashboard.discardedFacets: {{count}} attribute(s) left out of the statistics as free text: {{names}}.
dashboard.unavailableNotebooks: {{count}} notebook(s) did not answer, so these totals are short.

graph.heading: Notebook graph
graph.hint: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · click a note to open it, an attribute to hold its notes
graph.hintTouch: Pinch to zoom · drag to pan · tap a note to open it, an attribute to hold its notes
graph.empty: This notebook has no notes to draw yet.
graph.truncated: Showing the first 2000 notes of this notebook.

errors.validation: Something in what was sent is not accepted.
errors.conflict: This changed while you were working on it.
errors.preconditionFailed: This operation needs an explicit choice before it can run.
errors.limitExceeded: This is past the limit the product declares.
errors.offline: The application could not reach the server.

environment.disposable: What is written in this environment is disposable.
